command.name: serve
command.summary: Serve Pea OS to a browser and print its URL

option.name: port
option.summary: Stable workspace port; an occupied port reports an error

option.name: host
option.summary: Address to listen on; use 0.0.0.0 to reach it from a phone

option.name: data
option.summary: Folder for files kept on disk (default: ~/.local/share/pea-os)

command.name: check
command.summary: Validate the manifest, every XML resource and every app

command.name: list
command.summary: List what the manifest installs, one tab-separated row each

argument.name: kind
argument.summary: apps, themes, fonts, sprites or components (default: apps)

command.name: shot
command.summary: Render Pea OS without a browser and write a PNG

option.name: output
option.summary: Write the PNG to FILE instead of stdout

option.name: frames
option.summary: Frames to run before the shot, at 60 per second

option.name: scale
option.summary: Enlarge each art pixel N times in the PNG

option.name: tap
option.summary: Tap a point, in art pixels, before the shot; repeatable

option.name: context
option.summary: Right-click a point after the taps, to open its context menu; repeatable

command.name: settings
command.summary: Validate a settings.xml and print it in canonical form

argument.name: file
argument.summary: The file to read; standard input when omitted or -

option.name: defaults
option.summary: Print the default settings instead of reading any
